weeks.topic: Phonemic Awareness & Listening rhymes and songs with correct pronunciation.
weeks.content: Identify beginning and ending sounds in words; recite

Learn short vowel sounds (a, e, i, o, u); write simple CVC
words correctly.

Read simple sentences aloud; identify nouns (names of
people, animals, things).

Introduce self and others using simple sentences ("My
name is...", "This is my friend..."); use of articles a/an.
Assessment on phonics, reading, and sentence building.

weeks.topic: Reading Comprehension & write two to three sentences about school. Writing
weeks.content: Read short stories; answer "who" and "what" questions;

Identify and use singular and plural nouns (boy/boys,
child/children); pronounce clearly in speech.

Common greetings and polite requests ("Good morning",
"Please", "Thank you"); write short dialogues.

Identify simple verbs (run, jump, eat, sing); form simple
sentences using verbs.

Practice neat handwriting; write short sentences using
correct punctuation.
Review of all topics covered in the term.
